name: km2-mcp
description: Lets Claude build courses, records, views, and workflows in the Red Arch Knowledge Manager as the signed-in user.
long_description: Connects Claude to a Red Arch Knowledge Manager deployment. You sign in once through the app's normal login in a Chrome window; after that Claude acts strictly as you — same permissions, same org scoping. 69 tools covering courses/records, entities, forms, views, workflows, documents, and search. The target deployment's URLs are stamped in at pack time (scripts/pack-mcpb.sh); this checked-in copy defaults to a local dev stack.
